name: stockpilot
description: StockPilot - inventory tracker for small shops (React + TypeScript, Express, Prisma, SQLite)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:setup -w server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.build:netlify: npm run db:demo -w server && npm run build -w client
